thread:
elaine: opened PR 712 to simplify the observability quickstart. Goal: single compact dashboard YAML + JS and Go snippets, and a short cost/latency table. Also found one dead link in the tracehook section.

paul: I can do the JS snippet. keep it minimal and show attaching trace metadata and cost tags.

elaine: prefer JS + Go so we cover web and backend examples. Also we need to rename old metric keys to the new `redwood.request.latency.p50`/`p95` names.

docs-bot: lint: docs/obs_quickstart.md -> broken link https://old.link/tracehook (404).

harry: I'll replace the link and add a redirect. Also will update the dashboard YAML to reference the new metric names.

paul: draft JS snippet:
```js
const client = new Redwood.Client(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY);
const ctx = client.newTrace('obs-quickstart');
ctx.setTag('cost_center', 'web-play');
const res = await client.dashboards.render(ctx, 'compact');
console.log(res.shareUrl);
```

elaine: nice. add a one-line comment about tuning `maxBatchTokens` to trade cost vs p95.

harry: redirects are in infra, PR updated with new image and metric names. CI will run linkcheck.

ci-bot: queued: docs linkcheck + frontmatter smoke test.

elaine: aiming to merge today; if CI green I'll request reviews and ship to staging build. Thanks!
